name: Синтетична випускниця-психологиня: over_length (~890 слів), missing_contact (немає email), порушений хронологічний порядок, довгий список курсів, пункт від першої особи, рядок References і два сильні пункти (strong_keep)

profile.background: BA in Psychology at Odesa Coastal University (June 2026); peer support group facilitator at Seaside Youth Hub since January 2025; internship at Harbour Light Counselling Centre in summer 2024.

profile.vacancy_text: Psychosocial Support Assistant (NGO, Odesa). You will support the psychologist in group sessions for young people, keep confidential case records, prepare materials for workshops and help with intake conversations. Requirements: degree in psychology, experience with groups, Ukrainian and English, strict confidentiality.
